tolerance_rationale: ADR 0005: the 4-bit tier does not promise bit-exactness; the operator criterion is |delta| <= 1 code and cosine >= 0.9999. Per-channel multipliers are outside reports/Q02-int8-bitexact.md (tensor-level only), so int8_tol=1.

quality_criterion.code_criterion: device vs quantised golden: |delta| <= int8_tol codes

accuracy_vs_fp32.note: int8 quantisation error of the whole 4W8A path, no device involved
